nom: Lancôme Rénergie H.P.N. 300-Peptide Anti-Aging Cream SPF 25

avis.texte: This is a really nice cream. It has a great consistency. It isn't so great for me. It makes my face so shiny. I have oily skin to begin with, so that is definitely part of it. I love the night cream from this same line of products. This particular product is not for me, unfortunately.

avis.titre: I will be buying this product again
avis.texte: I love this profuct i like the my skin feels and looks my skin is soft smooth hydrated not greasy. Excellent product i cant say enough about this product. As soon as i run out i will buy again then again. This product starts the off right when your getting ready!
This is way to thick to wear during the day. It obliterated my make up and felt gross.

I would agree with others that the smell is strong but it doesnt last long. The smell goes away fairly quickly. I would use it at night and my skin would be so soft in the morning. I did buy it on sale and if it went on sale again, i would purchase again.
I use this instead of my usual moisturizer now. The Renergie H.P.N. 300-Peptide Cream SPF 25 out performs alot of creams I have tried in the past. I highly recommend this cream to anyone.

avis.titre: I would purchase this item again.
avis.texte: I have been using Lancome for many years now and very happy with this product.
Been wearing this for a couple years, previously used Benefait Total. Goes on light amd smooth and makes it easy to wear sunscren.

avis.titre: This product is a must have.
avis.texte: I love this product. It helps my skin stay hydrated and lifts it up.

This has lasted me forever--because I hate using it. Smells and feels like sunscreen. Some people obviously love it for their skin, but for mine it looks and feels oily and never absorbs. I only use it when I'm out of everything else. It feels like wearing wasted potential.
This is a great anti-aging moisturizer, i can see the results in a short period of time, leaves a natural glow not a greasy complexion.
My opinion of this lotion is, that it's smells and feels nice on my skin
I thought it helped with a wrinkle very quickly. I especially like that it has SPF in it. When it first came out, it didn't have that. I was going to wait until Lancôme made it with it.

avis.titre: I would by this product again
avis.texte: Excellent for a healthy and beautiful skin, no wrinkles in your face!

I'm overall satisfied with the face cream. It moisturizes your skin and doesn't feel sticky at all. I love the feel of it and how it glides on smoothly without any noticeable residue. Also improved the look of my lines and wrinkles.
Not worth the $$$. I find the Elemis marine cream does more than this one. I have been using for awhile & don't see any difference. I use along w/ the matching Lancome serum.
I have been using this product since I received it (which has been 2 weeks) and so far it has not improved my wrinkles or dark spots.
This product is simply ok, for women over 40. It's definitely not my the best for this age group. The spirit is hard on the eyes.
I have been able to see fine lines disappear my face feels softer and I feel great
This cream was absolutely good it worked in so many different ways for my skin helped my complexion my texture of my face helped reduce lines made my skin look nice and firm just overall good
Recieved a sample of this and its just reeks of perfume and its not a flattering type of smell, remind me of my grandma house. Its too thick and texture reminds me of ointment cream.

I was so happy to have the chance to review this amazing sunscreen! At first it felt very thick, but that was just a small sensory issue. I love it very much and feel like it had benefitted me so much.

I've been using this product for the past couple of weeks and I am impressed! It's smooth, it's thick but not greasy and no white cast. It's been a great addition to my skincare regimen. I usually use SPF and a light moisturizer but this is a combo day cream and it's so great!

avis.titre: I Would Buy This Product Again
avis.texte: I really like the Lancome Renergie peptide cream with SPF 25 as it feels luxurious on my skin and has anti-aging benefits. It glides on smooth and feels light. It also has a very pleasant scent. You wear it under your makeup as the peptides help combat sagging and wrinkles. However, you can wear it alone due to the SPF. I'm turning 56 and feel that it has improved my skin's texture.

I have been using Lanome Renergie H.P.N. 300 Peptide cream for a couple of weeks now and I am so pleased. I use it in the morning after my ritual cleansing routine. It glides on easily and soaks into the skin beautifully. It has a very luxurious feel to it. Creamy and sumptious. I can already see a difference in my fine lines and some of my sun spots have faded as well. My skin has a dewy look to it. My husband even commented on my glowing skin! The spf 25 has helped on my daily walks. I highly recommend this Lancôme Renergie day cream and will purchase when I finish this one. Thank you Lancôme and BzzAgent for this opportunity to fall in love with my skin again.

I love luxury skincare and I love more luxury skincare that actually works and this cream is pure delightful, every time that I applied it into my face. I really feel my skin hydrated and soft, smells delicious and has 25 spf.

I used this product for a full 30 days and I didn't like the film left on my face. It took a few minutes to dry down and I don't feel like the moisture absorbed in my skin, but rather just lay on the top of my skin. I've used better moisturizers.
Best daily moisturizer ever! Grateful sunscreen has been added so I may wear nothing on my face but it (and Génifique serum underneath)!
I've just started using this cream about one week ago and I love it. I can see the difference My skin looks great, smooth and fresh.
I used 3 jar already and love it so much,it makes my skin super soft all day long

avis.titre: I'm glad I'm going to try it!
avis.texte: My friend recommended it to me and I am glad that I will give it the opportunity to try it. Once I try it, I will share my experience through a review. Thank you!

I like the Renergie H.P.N cream. My skin is much smoother and my dark spots are less visible. Blends well with my liquid foundation. My only wish was that it had higher SPF. Most likely I will buy it again.
Nice and lightweight no sticky or greasy. Love that it has spf and a nice light scent.

avis.titre: Love the texture and overall richness
avis.texte: I've been using this every morning for a few weeks. I don't think it has reduced any wrinkles/lines but it is rich and my skin feels hydrated all day. My make up goes on nicely on top and stays on. I'm happy overall.
Like the texture and feeling on my face. Great for spring & summer, not sure about winter yet.

avis.titre: Amazing Product, One to Add to Your Arsenal
avis.texte: Rénergie H.P.N. 300-Peptide Cream Spf 25 was so soothing and pampering to my thirsty skin. The subtle citrussy scent was pleasant and added to the experience. Lancome created another one that surpasses expectations. This cream made my face feel so soft and supple. It was a wonderful trial.

avis.titre: It's okay, would probably not buy again
avis.texte: I had tried this product without SPF and really loved it, this formulation with SPF is a completely different consistency and doesn't feel as moisturizing. I also think this may be causing me to break out.

avis.titre: Good cream price is not worth the value
avis.texte: I Love the cream but the price shot up to the point that you are not getting what yo pay for and the jar got smaller which is disappointing especially since I always buy the largest jar.
Love this cream. I'm on my 60's but look younger than most 40 yrs old.

I recently started using the Lancôme Rénergie H.P.N. 300 Peptide Cream, and I am thoroughly impressed with the results. From the elegant packaging to the luxurious texture, this cream exudes quality. Upon application, it feels rich and hydrating without being greasy, which is perfect for my combination skin. After a few weeks of consistent use, I noticed a significant improvement in my skin's firmness and elasticity. Fine lines and wrinkles appeared less pronounced, giving my complexion a smoother, more youthful look. The peptides and other active ingredients seem to work wonders in revitalizing my skin. Additionally, I love the subtle, pleasant fragrance which adds to the overall experience without being overpowering. Overall, the Lancôme Rénergie H.P.N. 300 Peptide Cream has become a staple in my skincare routine. It's a bit of an investment, but the noticeable results and luxurious feel make it worth every penny. I highly recommend it to anyone looking to enhance their skincare regimen with a potent anti-aging product.
I've just been using this product for 3 months and I love how it makes my skin feel & look

avis.titre: Finally an spf moisturizer from Lancome
avis.texte: I was asked to review this product. I was already using Lancome moisturizer and I o Comparing Lancome to JLO's products... I thought they were similar, but Jlo has spf which pulled it ahead...until I received the 300 peptide cream, with spf 25. I've been using it almost daily and the results are great. I love having the spf built into the moisturizer
This is light,and goes great under makeup. i have very sensitive skin,especially in regards to sunscreen,but did not react to this.
This made my skin feel soft and rejuvenated! I love that it has SPF. I have extremely fair skin and I love having SPF infused into my products.

Most products containing SPF really flare up my sensitive rosacea skin, but this DID NOT. It really does well on removing dry patches and provides smooth, vibrant skin after just a couple of uses. The packaging is beautiful providing a luxury experience. The only con is it does not absorb well enough and therefore my makeup does not last all day like it does with other fully absorbing moisturizers.
It was a simple application. Due to my sensitive skin it worked out perfectly for me. Definitely good for the sun.

avis.titre: Health Glowing Skin with Anti Aging Benefits
avis.texte: After cleansing skin with a face wash pat skin dry. Apply in small dots to the face and massage in gently. When applying to eye area lightly tap in the skin under eye area softly with finger as this area is delicate. This is also a product that can be applied with a brush or jade roller and massaged in with a gua sha for added face sculpture and anti aging and wrinkles benefits. I Love it!!!
This cream is excellent as a daily final cream. The new formula is excellent and SPF is great

I have been using for about 3 weeks. I love the smoothness that it applies. With the peptides I can see my skin firming and looking refreshed and renewed. It also smells wonderful. The fact that it also has an spf high enough to add to my daytime routine means ones less product.
I used this for almost 3 weeks and it has almost completely transformed my skin. It feels so soft and so much more youthful! You won't be disappointed!

avis.titre: Nice but may be too heavy for my skin
avis.texte: Next time I'm hoping we were given full time to test true 60-90 days for true potency. I like texture of the creme but I fear it's a bit too heavy for my combination sensitive skin.

Lancome's Renergie day cream provides all day moisturizer with SPF. It is light and gentle on combination skin. However, I did not notice any significant improvement in my skin's texture and appearance.

This was a a luxurious cream. It's packed with different peptides, plus spf was an added bonus. I definitely noticed a difference in my skin after 2 weeks. Lines were softer, skin was more plump and hydrated. My daughter complimented, my skin was looking nice. Definitely would use this product again!

After using this product for 3 weeks I am in love! Application is silky smooth, it feels luxurious. I love that this peptide cream rubs in so nicely and doesn't leave my skin feeling oily or tacky. It dries and can be flawlessly layered with makeup or other products. I have noticed such an improvement in the texture and redness on my face. My skin tone appears more even and feels plump and hydrated. The scent of this face cream is clean and light. I also appreciate that they offer a refill option to reduce plastic waste when it's time to repurchase.

avis.titre: I am in love with this product!
avis.texte: I was delighted to get the opportunity to review & try this product! SPF25 plus all of the things a girl in her 50's needs in a moisturizer, pleasant smell (barely any scent at all), non-greasy, make-up goes on smoothly over it. I have been using this for several weeks, noticing a decrease in fine lines, smoothing my skin overall & those darned dark spots from sunworshiping are fading & looking lighter. I love the idea of a product that will reduce lower face sagging bc that seems to be a trouble spot & where things start (no pun intended) start going south after 50. I don't need much to cover my face & neck area which means that it will last quite a while. I look forward to seeing more results with longer use. Will I purchase it? Yes I will & I will tell all of my friends bc this stuff is fabulous!!!
I love this product! Long lasting, all day wear. Smooth and creamy, not greasy. After using for awhile can tell a noticeable difference and improvement in my skin.

I received this free product from BzzAgent and Lancôme in exchange for my honest review. This cream hydrates and moisturizes my skin. It leaves my skin glowy and ready to apply makeup. I noticed my fine lines and my large pores are less noticeable after few weeks. It has a subtle scent. I'm very satisfied with this product since it's very gentle with my sensitive skin.

This cream is a great addition to my skincare routine. I love that It has SPF so I can use during the day to protect my skin. It leaves my skin feeling plumped and juicy. My skin feels much more smoother and youthful.

I would never have believed this change in product could make such a difference in my skin. This cream has given my face a softness that feels delicious and a glow that I haven't had before. This is my new favorite product.

When I used this product the first few days, I was instantly floored! I felt like my skin was brighter and dewy, the added benefits of peptides and SPF is also a huge plus. Initially I really loved the idea of this product because of my curiosity of starting to use peptides in my skincare routine. I was excited to be sent this product and to also finally give the Lancome skincare line a try. This cream is a little thicker than I am used to for a day cream in the Spring/Summer but the texture was smooth, a little greasy, and the scent is pleasant. After about a couple of weeks, I noticed my pores were a bit clogged with whiteheads and I had a couple of breakouts. Now I will say, the warm weather is probably not suited for this type of day cream on my combination skin so I can see this cream being way better for me in the cooler, dryer Fall/Winter seasons and will wait to give it a full re-try again then. I still think this is a great day cream to try if you are looking for something with SPF and has the added anti-aging benefits.

I was very excited to receive the Renergie H.P.N. 300 peptide cream spf 25. Heading into summer I especially look for products with SPF. I have been using this product for a few weeks and love the fresh clean smell and love how it absorbs into my skin. My stays hydrated and is visibly firmer.

Pleasantly scented with just the slightest floral scent this moisturizer with added spf protects your skin against sun. It is creamy and rich and leaves your skin feeling moisturized and smooth. It's easily applied and quickly absorbed into your skin not leaving it looking greasy. It also didn't look cakey or pilly under my makeup. A must add to any skin routine.

I was excited to know that I could try this cream since it is from an accessible luxury brand, and as soon as it arrived I wanted to try it. The consistency is soft and very light, it doesn't feel heavy or greasy at all but when I smelled it I realized that I couldn't use it since my skin is sensitive and although the aroma is light I wanted to give it a try and with the first use I could feel that uncomfortable and itchy. So I knew it wouldn't be for me.
Luxurious box design. After a few weeks of use, the skin has changed, the skin is brighter, smoother, and brown spots have improved

Rénergie H.P.N. 300-Peptide Cream Spf 2 is thick and creamy but absorbs very well into my skin. This cream worked well at reducing my dark spots and protecting my skin against aging. I like that the 300 peptides stimulates faster and enhanced skin renewal.

I have used this Lancome peptide face cream with spf for the past few weeks and I am really enjoying it. It is very hydrating and doesn't irritate my sensitive skin with the chemical spf like other products do. I also find my makeup layers well on top of it which for me is a tell of a great moisturizer.
In love with Lancôme Rénergie HPN 300-Peptide Cream with SPF 25 💖 It's about to become my go-to summer moisturizer- hydrating, healing, anti-aging and sunscreen. Nothing short of fantastic, IMO 🧖🏼‍♀️
I'm trying a different product to substitute for Renergie Anti-aging moisturizer which is out of stock. I have used Renergie for many, many years. It's my favorite!! This new product is good so far.

Disclosure: I received this product complimentary from BzzAgent in exchange for my honest review. All opinions are my own. I am located in a fairly humid area and was concerned this may be too thin for me, but it was perfect! It absorbed in the skin quickly and was a really thin in consistency, After about two weeks of using I noticed changes in my skin. It looked much more plump than prior to using. I noticed a lot of difference in the overall appearance of my skin as well as some fine lines appearing much fuller. Did not notice a white cast with the SPF in the product and as an almost daily make-up wearer, I was able to apply make-up over it just fine with my regular skincare routine.
I like the feel of this moisturizer. It absorbs fairly quickly and I like the idea that the SPF 25 protects my skin on a day-to-day basis.

I really like this Lancôme Renergie HPN 300 Peptide SPF 25. It applies nicely and absorbs quickly and easily. No white cast at all. I just don't love the scent of it. It's heavily floral scented and I just don't like any skin products to be scented. For it to be that scented and be right on my face is very unpleasant for me. If it wasn't for the scent I feel I would love this SPF. I would recommend it to people who don't mind floral scented products.

I love what a great multitasker this product is! I noticed after a few days of using this product that my skin felt very hydrated and so soft. I have also noticed the softening of some of my fine lines. The formula is non-greasy, has a pleasant smell and the added bonus of spf-something I feel every moisturizer should have.

avis.titre: Nowhere near as good as the non SPF version
avis.texte: I decided to try the version with SPF instead of the regular Renergie HPN peptide cream, which I really love The consistency isn't nice like the original version and it has made me break out terribly. I'll be switching back to the non SPF version, pity I bought the huge bottle of the SPF version :(

I've been using this product for a few weeks now. It's very lightweight and is easy to apply. It's a thin facial cream and smells good, too. It's working well so far, leaves my skin a little red after application.

This cream is nice, though I think I would like it more without the SPF. You get that SPF "feel" after a while. It's not a heavy feeling, but it feels more noticeable than a moisturizer without SPF. Generally, it is nice to have the added SPF in such a nice cream for convenience. I will continue to use it.

avis.titre: The perfect day cream that protects from the sun!
avis.texte: This is a great day cream and last step to any daytime skincare routine. It hydrates in the best way while giving a dewy finish and not your typical greasy SPF residue leaving cream that many SPF creams on the market, in my opinion, leave my skin feeling. I live in Florida so a SPF cream is required and in the past I have left that step out because I am prone to break outs and clogged pores. This is the best of both worlds and does not leave the skin feeling yucky while still protecting from harmful UV rays.

I have been using the product every night and enjoy the luxurious texture and has helped with my fine lines and wrinkles! The one downside which is why I didn't give it 5 stars was due to the use of fragrance. In a high-end produce like this I would expect it to be fragrance free. I have sensitive skin so tend to avoid things with fragrance in them.

I used this cream every morning. It made a great sunscreen! I was outside a lot and NEVER got sunburned on my face. It also appeared to have softened some of the wrinkles on my forehead. I have sensitive skin with rosacea and did not have any burning or redness with use. I did not notice a reduction in dark spots or that it firmed my skin at all. The only issue I had was if I got sweaty working outside, the cream did burn my eyes. I received the product free in exchange for my honest opinion.

I absolutely LOVED this product!! I searched, and couldn't find anything I didn't love. From the packaging to performance this product is LUXURY! Its lightweight formula packed a heavyweight punch with productivity. My skin was brighter, firmer, healthier, and moisturized without getting oily. I would highly recommend this and won't hesitate to buy the entire product line. I loved it and you will too!

I received this product a few weeks ago to try out and review. Since using this, my dark spots have improved, starting to see them fading. Makes my skin feel hydrated, but not greasy, like some SPC creams. No white cast. Dries down nicely and my makeup applies very smoothly over it. Works well with various primers too. Hoping to see some improvement on my forehead lines, time will tell. If you are looking for a day cream, and are not sensitive to fragrance, I highly recommend this!! Bonus is that it's refillable, and the refills are cheaper.

avis.titre: I Would buy this product again and again
avis.texte: I use the cream every morning and night and I love the way it makes my skin Look and Overall Brighter Skin and makes it real soft
Absolutely love the texture of this product and how it just melts into the skin. Have been seeing amazing results as well!

Lancome Rénergie H.P.N. 300-Peptide Cream Spf 25 is thick, rich, and creamy. It leaves my face feeling soft and nourished. Even my husband mentioned that my skin has a glow to it and was softer. Honestly, I was stunned he noticed, which definitely states how well this cream has been working for me. With a SPF of 25, it also helps protect my face from sun damage. The sun and I are not friends. It has a pleasant, slightly floral scent. Ther packaging is attractive and it would make a lovely gift.

I like this product! There's not really a scent and it's feels very rich to the touch. I do wish it had a higher SPF and it wasn't expensive. Would I purchase again maybe because of the price range however I recommend it to family and friends.

I've always had a love/hate relationship with day creams that contain SPF. Although I completely understand the importance of SPF, I'm not sure if it's the scent, white cast or greasiness I associate with sunscreens but I'm pretty picky when it comes to moisturizers with added SPF. I've tried many and this Rénergie H.P.N. 300-Peptide Anti-Aging Cream SPF 25 from Lancôme is definitely one of the best. It's very hydrating without feeling too heavy. My face tends to sweat ALOT and it doesn't feel like it just sits on the surface of my skin and roll off throughout the day. It makes my skin feel plump & smooth when I use it consistently and it leaves my skin looking radiant & healthy! As usual there's just something special to me about Lancôme products, I've been using them since I was very young…I would sneak through my moms products growing up (which were mainly all Lancôme) and use everything I could find lol!! (sorry mom LOL) Plus the packaging is gorgeous!! I'm proud to display this jar on my dresser!

I love that this has spf but I just wish the amount of spf was higher. It's a very lightweight cream and has a nice floral scent to it. I personally tend to shy away from fragrance but this wasn't too bad. It's a very hydrating cream. My only complaint is the amount of spf.

I received this product for free in exchange for my honest opinion. Here we go. I googled this product and it's pricey. So not worth it. First...the smell: it's overwhelming and obnoxious. It smells like something from Avon circa 1954 that has gone bad in the back of great aunt Marge's vanity and was found last year after she died. This is a PRESTIGE brand; why does it smell like something the coroner would use too cover decomp? Second: I have no idea if it is the perfume or the chemicals, but my eyes BURNED...they watered like someone had thrown chemicals directly into my eyes. I am not a particularly sensitive person. Either to scents or ingredients. But this was awful. I tried applying to the back of my hand and gently spreading to let the product "dry down" slightly. Nope. It was just as bad. Just having it on the back of my hands made my eyes water. I can't imagine how bad it would be if you actually had allergies to these products.

avis.titre: Amazing Day Cream with SPF that firms & hydrates the skin!
avis.texte: I received this SPF day cream and I was very excited to try this cream. I used it every morning for a few weeks to get the full effects of the cream and I gotta say that this felt amazing on my skin! I loved that it was on the thicker, creamier side as a day cream but also included SPF 25. My skin felt firmer and more hydrated after having used it for a few weeks. I also love the smell of the cream which has a subtle rose smell.

avis.titre: I love how this blends so well with my skin and make up
avis.texte: Ever since I started using this, I no longer use the separate SPF that I was using daily before because this has enough for me. I appreciate that this goes on my face smoothly and has an amazing scent. I am also able to apply my make up on top of this without having to worry about it looking caked up or not mixing well when I apply any powder, I can easily apply more if I need to during the day and not worry about messing up my make up. I highly recommend this and have been using this every day and love the way my skin stays soft!

This is a luxurious feeling, thick cream. The SPF25 is a nice addition to a daily face cream. I have been using this peptide cream for a little over two weeks now and I have seen improvement in my melasma spots. I've also noticed my skin is more glowy. This cream is definitely pricey but for the visible results, I think it's worth it.

I received this anti-aging cream to try and I fell in love with it. I use Lancome Renergie night cream already so I knew how amazing this brand is. I tried this in tandem with the night cream for a few weeks and I can honestly say I noticed a difference in how smooth my face felt, it not only feels supple but you can see a difference in the lines they are not as pronounced. The fact that this has SPF to help protect my face from further sun damage is a major win. I had my night cream but now I have my day cream as well. The formula is nongreasy, their is a slight scent but it's not perfumey at all. It works well with my foundation. I would highly recommend this to anyone looking to protect their skin and reap the benefits of ant-aging skincare. The container holds alot of product and you don't need alot it spreads well and melts into the skin.

avis.titre: Wonderful product and worked great on my dry skin
avis.texte: Im 34 years old and I actually used this along with sending my 62 year old mother enough to sample it herself. I have extremely dry skin and seen a noticeable difference in the hydration of my skin. I'm also fair complected with auburn hair which the SPF is a massive benefit towards the protection of my skin. My mother also has fair skin, red hair, and has tons of beauty marks & freckles. She loved using this cream on her combination skin and being someone who's dealt with skin cancer in the past she told me this Lancome cream with SPF is one of her daily go to skincares.
A little bit goes a long way, amazing product to have. I can definitely see some improvement. It's by far the best product I have tried. My skin feels smooth and rejuvenated.
Loved this. Not oily, smells very light floral nothing too heavy. Don't feel tacky on skin. Dries down.
I really love how this made my skin feel. Definitely something I will be adding into my skin care routine.

Absolutely love this product, the SPF 25 sunscreen has worked perfectly to keep my skin from getting sunburnt on these beautiful days out. Not only that my skin feels more toned and youthful. Also my complexion looks flawless. And it smells lovely and the cream is just so rich.
It works well without leaving a weird residue, pilling or making my face too oily. Has kept me from getting sunburnt. Keeps skin moisturized throughout the day with no breakouts

I adore the smell of this cream, and the bottle it is in is beautiful. It's a great.consistency as well! I do wish it was higher than 25SPF though because I need to put on another product for sun protection
Love love love this product and I can't say that enough!! My skin is loving it as well, it's not heavy nor greasy. Leaves skin looking plump and hydrated

avis.titre: Smoother Skin was an Added Bonus!
avis.texte: The formulation of this cream is amazing! It made my skin go from dull and patchy to glowy and smooth. I was nervous about the SPF because it usually means it will cause some breakouts. This cream did the opposite. It smoothed out the texture and made my skin feel soft. The firmness is better as well. A game changer for those of us over 40 trying to keep everything put for as long as possible without alternative solutions.

I love this product! I do sometimes mix it with a spf skin tint but even on its own it's not greasy, the smell isn't strong and it makes my face feel hydrated all day! It doesn't pill under my makeup or leave a white cast either.

I have been using this anti-aging cream for about three weeks, and I am happy with the results. The cream is lightweight and absorbs quickly. After applying, my skin feels soft and hydrated. I have noticed that my fine lines are diminishing, and my skin feels and looks firmer. This product has a bit of pleasant fragrance, but it is not overpowering, and I am very pleased that it does not irritate my skin at all.
Anti-Aging Cream with SPF 25. It works great. After using this product couple weeks. My skin is look better. Highly recommended
Using Renergie H.P.N. 300-Peptide Cream has been awesome! Has been a great moisturizer and settles in well on my skin. I feel like some of my lines have lessened.
I love this moisturizer because my skin looks smooth and feels soft. I love the part that is 2 in 1. SPF on this moisturizer don't leave white cast and blend easily.
It feel good on the skin l, easy to spread and soft but depending on the skin it can feel a little greasy afterwards. You need to put just a little
I loved this cream! Skin felt so soft and supple after each use. Saw visible improvement in fine lines and gave me a youthful glow.
Great moisture for dry skin - my face and decollage area look much smoother. Best for dryer skin or those living in a dryer climate. I will save for winter.
I absolutely love this product. The addition of SPF sold me in this face cream. It's a must have in my skincare routine.
This newest iteration of this product is amazing all the sunscreen little bit of lightning for dark spots just great
It's good if you just need spf. It pills under foundation and concealer so not great if you plan on wearing that.

This cream made my face feel soft. The product didn't feel thick when putting on so that was a good thing! After the 1st 2 weeks I noticed a difference in my skin felt a little more firm than before I used it. Would try again

I really liked this product. It was nice because it has spf in it, which is very important to me. I liked that it was fairly thick, although during the summer it would be slightly too heavy for me. The fragrance wasn't overpowering, although noticeable. It was hydrating, but I didn't see any difference in fine lines.

I thoroughly love this product! It's light, creamy, texture goes on my skin smoothly. It absorbs quickly and leaves my skin feeling soft. I noticed visible results relatively quickly after starting to use the product. I highly recommend this product!!!

After using this spf moisturizer for many weeks, I can confidently say this is such a great hydrating moisturizer. It's not gel type light, but light enough while still giving a great hydration and has durability throughout the day which is something I highly look out for! I also love the smell so much!

avis.titre: Lancome, this is your biggest miss!
avis.texte: When I think of Lancome, I equate it with exquisite beauty products and luxuriousness. I have been loyal to Lancome products because they produce successful results. This however is the exception!! The only two things I liked was the fluffy pinkness of the texture and the fragrance. That's it. Upon the first use (at night before bed) my face turned red and the very next morning I had a pimple. I felt like a teenager. My face is NOT sensitive and I haven't broken out since puberty. I rested my face with no makeup and Cetaphil cleanser only for three days. I tried it again that morning under my makeup. My face itched and I accidently got some in my eyes and well that's a whole different story! I couldn't even wear eye makeup to work that day because my eyes were so red, irritated and watering constantly. I tried flushing them with water and using eye drops to no avail. I finally decided to only wear this to work as I was running late. I'm outside the first 1.5 hours and the rest of my day is inside. My face was sunburned! I couldn't believe it. Lancome, I have no idea where your manufacturing takes place and I've heard you also test on animals. Well, this product should've stopped at that very point. How it passed QC and nothing had a reaction is beyond my comprehension. I'm so disappointed! Saddened that a brand with products I adore has changed so much. Please take time to speak with your buyers, your chemists, your lab, your customers etc. Great products can still be made wi

The cream is more on the heavy side however when applying to my skin it felt light and didn't leave an oily feeling behind. After using a couple a weeks I've noticed my skin feels softer and has a welcoming glow. Definitely recommend. Thank you BuzzAgent and Lancome for allowing me to try this product at no cost.
Lancôme products are amazing. This cream makes my skin smoother, brighter and firmer! It moisturizes my skin and helps my face look a little more healthy and glowy!

I absolutely love this cream it truly looks and feels like a superior high quality product, at first I did get a bit of irritation but then my skin got used to the cream. Its scent is a nice floral and it absorbed perfectly without leaving a greasy feel. I love the packaging but it does as comes with less product then you'd think, but hey all high quality products do! I liked this cream I am starting to see its benefits already super moisturized skin and tighter skin I will continue to use can't wait for more results!

I received this product from Bzzagent and Lancome for free in exchange for my honest review. This cream is kind of a little heavy for my skin but it did absorbed to my skin and leave a smooth feeling. Scent is light rose and I like that it has SPF25 so doesn't need to use sun cream under it. So just apply it and then foundation and done with your make up. I love this product and will recommend to my friend to try this product.

I've been using this consistently for weeks. I have noticed my skin is more hydrated and supple. My skin feels luxe. My makeup lays better. A little goes a long way! Great for my hands too. My skin feels great and looks youthful.
